top_violation_types.title: Designating Director (26 TAC §744.201(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have a designated site director.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees - Orientation (26 TAC §744.1301(a)(1)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One staff is missing documentation of their orientation.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §744.3113(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not conducted a monthly playground maintenance check since October.

top_violation_types.title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §744.3559(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the inspection it was found that the drills were not documented.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees - Pre-Service (26 TAC §744.1301(a)(2)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregiver that require pre-service do not have pre-service on file.

top_violation_types.title: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption Attends High School - Enrolled in Approved Child-care Career Program (26 TAC §744.1107(b)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 1 of 5 employees, who is 17 years old, does not have proof of being enrolled in a program allowing her to be eligible to work in a licensed facility.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (26 TAC §744.901(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver lacked a notarized affidavit - Form 2985 -  in their documentation.

top_violation_types.title: Training requirements for substitutes, volunteers, and contractors-Orientation (26 TAC §744.1403(a)(1)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 4 of 5 personnel files did not have proof of orientation available for review at the time of the inspection.
